desc: 透明内衬挂位、易洁擦洗微距、空表选码与空白印章材质信任
name: 透明浴帘内衬易洁通透款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清内衬的通透度与整幅垂坠，赢下点击
用痛点卡片放大皂垢与霉斑焦虑，逼出换内衬的理由
用擦洗微距证明表面不挂污、日常免打理
把内衬放回真实淋浴瞬间，证明水被挡在内侧
用放松泡澡画面把内衬和疗愈生活方式绑定
用打孔区微距证明承重不撕裂，消除脱落疑虑
用下摆内嵌配重的特写解释帘身为何贴身不外飘
以整幅垂坠加空白纵向尺寸线预先化解尺寸疑虑
用分组空表格呈现多规格选码结构，让买家定位自己那档
以留空清单与空白印章框承接安全诉求，收口消除风险

style.backgroundSystem: bright field #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, sage green block #A9C0A4 and deep pine panel #4C6B57 for overlay cards, pale limestone #EDEAE4 for material and layout boards
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent, rounded seal frames left empty
style.lightingSystem: neutral studio light, soft front key with a bounce fill, gentle contact shadow under the hem, controlled glossy highlights on the transparent sheet, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bathroom textile visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bright field #FFFFFF, sage green block #A9C0A4, deep pine green panel #4C6B57 and pale limestone #EDEAE4; neutral studio lighting with a soft front key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the frame so all copy areas stay empty; rounded solid arch and card overlays with generous empty label rails; thin single-weight line icons; stable hanging scale and soft even drape; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rendered brand marks, seals or numbers inside overlay shapes
style.presentationRules: the liner hangs full height from a polished metal rod with C-shaped hooks, straight stable scale, soft even drape, overlays never cover more than half the product
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale limestone #EDEAE4 counter, veined light stone wall #E9E6E1, soft grey floor tile #DDDEDA
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, reserved for downstream copy only; every text area in this template renders as an empty rail or blank block
